title: Function set_times
description: Changes the timestamps of the file or directory at the specified path.

children.code: pub fn set_times<P: AsRef<Path>>(path: P, times: FileTimes) -> Result<()>

children.value: Changes the timestamps of the file or directory at the specified path.

This function will attempt to set the access and modification times to the times specified. If the path refers to a symbolic link, this function will follow the link and change the timestamps of the target file.
